title: phase-ports port contract bundle
description: The seven swappable TICK adapter ports, each declaring its input and output type by reference to the shared domain types in domain-types.json. A single bundle schema_version covers all seven ports (v1 decision 6). null denotes the unit type () for PULL input and CLEANUP output. [] denotes an array of the named type.
deprecation_criterion: superseded when per-port independent contract versioning replaces the single-bundle version (deferred to v2)
